pack.name: EmpireDivers Forge
pack.notes: EmpireDivers r50 (v2.1.2): Unstretched 74 JFO helmets + normalized oversized helmets + 7 stray Clone helmets replaced; missing upper arms (IE-3/PH-9/AF-50/FS-05), RE-2310 belly UV-void, inside-out meshes, DS-191/K-2SO bind/AABB, and Democracy Officer shoulder/MRA fixed; AAA Jedi: Fallen Order AT-ST with dual 2048px PBR & crisp cheek cannons; closed-hull SEAF & Extraction Lambdas (zero Pelican nose gear) + 3 Republic LAATs replaced; standard British Imperial Player/Admiral/Crew voices + 2,680 SEAF Stormtrooper lines (Encrypted Death Trooper opt-in OFF by default); crisp SEAF blasters, PEW-PEW Empire v3.2.3 + remaining weapon blasters, and all 11 Star Destroyer inbound turbolaser orbitals.
pack.statusNotes: Verified across all 5 tiers (full, lighter, reduced1024, reduced512, potato256) with 0 duplicate keys, 0 missing dependencies, 0 codec mismatches, and 100% unit_safe.
